authentication.description: X-API-Key header. Sign up via POST /v1/signup (key shown once, 100 starter credits). Email verification is required before the key can create pools or draw.

description: One quota pool, many agents, no overruns. A token-bucket pool with a refill rate, per-agent caps, and burst limits. Every draw, allowed or denied, gets a hash-chained receipt.
limits: Draws are denied when units exceed the burst limit, the pool's available units, or the agent's allowed draws inside the rolling 60-minute window would exceed the per-agent cap.
Per-agent cap window is a rolling 60 minutes — a documented design choice, not a calendar window.
Not a payment system, not a rate limiter for HTTP, not a wisdom judgement.
name: ForgingStack Ration

pricing.note: 1 credit per pool creation and 1 credit per draw call, allowed or denied — the draw was performed. Idempotent replays are free. Top-ups, pool reads, pool lists, and deletes are free.
